name: SecOps-NG: DORA Art. 19 major-ICT-related incident reporting lifecycle

values.name: __incident_id__
values.description: Identifier of the ICT-related incident this reporting cycle discharges. Read against the operator's incident register; upstream classification is done by the deterministic Art. 18 classifier under Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1772.

values.name: __reporting_window__
values.description: Identifier of the DORA Art. 19 reporting cycle window this run discharges — names which incident-cycle cohort the run reports against. Wall-clock timestamps live on each emitted submission artifact.

values.name: __classification_criteria__
values.description: The operator's per-criterion determinations under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1772: exactly critical_services_affected and malicious_unauthorised_access (real booleans) and materiality, one real boolean per materiality criterion saying whether the operator's policy found its threshold met. The threshold rules themselves stay with the operator's classification policy.

values.name: __classified_at__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) of the classification; the reporting clocks start here.

values.name: __aggregation__
values.description: The recurring-incident block when the criteria describe recurring incidents' collective impact: incident_refs (two or more), same_apparent_root_cause, first_occurred_at and last_occurred_at. Empty for a single incident (the n8n trigger supplies an empty string for an unset variable).

values.name: __aware_at__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) the operator became aware of the incident; the initial notification's 24-hour limit runs from it.

values.name: __source_url__
values.description: URL of the workflow run that produces the reports, recorded in each report's provenance.

values.name: __initial_submitted_at__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) the initial notification is submitted at.

values.name: __initial_impact__
values.description: The impact figures the initial notification reports: any of affected_functions, affected_clients_count, duration_minutes, geographic_scope, data_loss_indicator and indicators_of_compromise.

values.name: __initial_mitigation__
values.description: The mitigation status the initial notification reports: state, and any of actions_in_flight, completed_actions, root_cause and residual_risk.

values.name: __initial_submission_ref__
values.description: The authority's acknowledgement reference for the initial notification, when the adapter has one; empty otherwise (the n8n trigger supplies an empty string for an unset variable), and then omitted from the report.

values.name: __intermediate_submitted_at__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) the intermediate report is submitted at.

values.name: __intermediate_impact__
values.description: The impact figures the intermediate report reports: any of affected_functions, affected_clients_count, duration_minutes, geographic_scope, data_loss_indicator and indicators_of_compromise.

values.name: __intermediate_mitigation__
values.description: The mitigation status the intermediate report reports: state, and any of actions_in_flight, completed_actions, root_cause and residual_risk.

values.name: __intermediate_submission_ref__
values.description: The authority's acknowledgement reference for the intermediate report, when the adapter has one; empty otherwise (the n8n trigger supplies an empty string for an unset variable), and then omitted from the report.

values.name: __final_submitted_at__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) the final report is submitted at.

values.name: __final_impact__
values.description: The impact figures the final report reports: any of affected_functions, affected_clients_count, duration_minutes, geographic_scope, data_loss_indicator and indicators_of_compromise.

values.name: __final_mitigation__
values.description: The mitigation status the final report reports: state, and any of actions_in_flight, completed_actions, root_cause and residual_risk.

values.name: __final_submission_ref__
values.description: The authority's acknowledgement reference for the final report, when the adapter has one; empty otherwise (the n8n trigger supplies an empty string for an unset variable), and then omitted from the report.

values.name: __cross_regime_refs__
values.description: References to notifications filed under other regimes for the same incident (the NIS2 Art. 23 early warning, the GDPR Art. 33 notification). CACAO v2 has no list type, so the value rides as a string carrying a JSON-native list; the compile target's adapter seam marshals it.

values.name: __workflow_id__
values.description: Identifier of the workflow, folded into the archive's artifact_id.

values.name: __execution_id__
values.description: Identifier of this execution, folded into the archive's artifact_id.

values.name: __captured_at__
values.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) the archive is captured at, folded into its artifact_id.

values.name: __classification_decision_id__
values.description: Identifier of the Art. 18 classification decision. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __classification__.classification_id.

values.name: __initial_notification_id__
values.description: Identifier of the Art. 19(4)(a) initial notification. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __initial_notification__.report.report_id.

values.name: __intermediate_report_id__
values.description: Identifier of the Art. 19(4)(b) intermediate report. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __intermediate_report__.report.report_id.

values.name: __final_report_id__
values.description: Identifier of the Art. 19(4)(c) final report. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __final_report__.report.report_id.

values.name: __cycle_archive_id__
values.description: Identifier of the cycle-archival record. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __cycle_archive__.artifact_id.

values.name: __classification__
values.description: Envelope the classify step emits: major as a real boolean, its basis, the materiality thresholds met, the rule ids and reasons, and the recurring-incident aggregation when there is one.

values.name: __incident_major__
values.description: Whether the incident is classified as major; false skips the three reports and goes straight to the archive. Extracted at the compile target's adapter seam from __classification__.major. A real boolean: the gate compares it to true, and the string 'false' is truthy in most runtimes.

values.name: __initial_notification__
values.description: Envelope the initial-notification step emits: the schema-conforming Art. 19 report, due_at, within_deadline and the deadline basis.

values.name: __intermediate_report__
values.description: Envelope the intermediate-report step emits, in the same shape, linked to the initial notification.

values.name: __final_report__
values.description: Envelope the final-report step emits, in the same shape, linked to the intermediate report.

values.name: __cycle_archive__
values.description: Envelope the archive step emits: the classification, each milestone with its deadline outcome, whether every deadline was met, and the cross-regime references.

nodes.name: detect and classify

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.dora_major_incident_reporting.primitives.classification import classify_major_incident
__classification__ = classify_major_incident(incident_id=__incident_id__, criteria=__classification_criteria__, classified_at=__classified_at__, aggregation=__aggregation__)

nodes.notes: Apply the Art. 8(1) combination rule of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1772 to the operator's per-criterion determinations: an incident is major when a critical service is affected and either malicious unauthorised access that may result in data losses was identified, or at least two materiality thresholds are met. Recurring incidents with the same apparent root cause are classified on their collective impact. Produces __classification__, from which __classification_decision_id__ and __incident_major__ are extracted; the not-major gate reads the latter.

nodes.name: major incident?
nodes.notes: Branch on __incident_major__, extracted from the classification. True files the three Art. 19 reports in order; false skips them, because a non-major incident is not reported under Art. 19, and goes straight to the archive, which closes the cycle on both branches.

nodes.name: notify authority initial

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.dora_major_incident_reporting.primitives.notification import compose_initial_notification
__initial_notification__ = compose_initial_notification(classification=__classification__, reporting_window=__reporting_window__, aware_at=__aware_at__, submitted_at=__initial_submitted_at__, impact=__initial_impact__, mitigation=__initial_mitigation__, source_url=__source_url__, submission_ref=__initial_submission_ref__)

nodes.notes: Compose the Art. 19(4)(a) initial notification as a schema-conforming report, due within four hours of classification and no later than 24 hours after awareness, or four hours after a classification made more than 24 hours after awareness (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/301, Art. 5(1)(a) and 5(2)). Submission to the competent authority is the adapter's. Produces __initial_notification__, from which __initial_notification_id__ is extracted.

nodes.name: notify authority intermediate

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.dora_major_incident_reporting.primitives.notification import compose_intermediate_report
__intermediate_report__ = compose_intermediate_report(classification=__classification__, initial=__initial_notification__, reporting_window=__reporting_window__, aware_at=__aware_at__, submitted_at=__intermediate_submitted_at__, impact=__intermediate_impact__, mitigation=__intermediate_mitigation__, source_url=__source_url__, submission_ref=__intermediate_submission_ref__)

nodes.notes: Compose the Art. 19(4)(b) intermediate report, linked to the initial notification, due within 72 hours of the submission of the initial notification (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/301, Art. 5(1)(b)), not of classification. An updated intermediate report is owed when regular activities have recovered. Produces __intermediate_report__, from which __intermediate_report_id__ is extracted.

nodes.name: notify authority final

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.dora_major_incident_reporting.primitives.notification import compose_final_report
__final_report__ = compose_final_report(classification=__classification__, intermediate=__intermediate_report__, reporting_window=__reporting_window__, aware_at=__aware_at__, submitted_at=__final_submitted_at__, impact=__final_impact__, mitigation=__final_mitigation__, source_url=__source_url__, submission_ref=__final_submission_ref__)

nodes.notes: Compose the Art. 19(4)(c) final report, linked to the intermediate report, due no later than one month after the intermediate report was submitted (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/301, Art. 5(1)(c)). Produces __final_report__, from which __final_report_id__ is extracted.

nodes.name: close and archive

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.dora_major_incident_reporting.primitives.archive import compose_cycle_archive
__cycle_archive__ = compose_cycle_archive(classification=__classification__, initial=__initial_notification__, intermediate=__intermediate_report__, final=__final_report__, cross_regime_refs=__cross_regime_refs__, workflow_id=__workflow_id__, execution_id=__execution_id__, captured_at=__captured_at__)

nodes.notes: Compose the dated cycle-archival record on both branches: the classification, the three reports with their deadline outcomes for a major incident, none for a non-major one, and references to the notifications filed under other regimes (NIS2 Art. 23, GDPR Art. 33). A major cycle without its complete chain, or a non-major one with a report attached, fails loud. Produces __cycle_archive__, from which __cycle_archive_id__ is extracted.

parameters.content:
## DORA Art. 19 major-ICT-related incident reporting lifecycle
`playbook.dora_major_incident_reporting@v1` · content v1.0.0 · maturity: stable · compiled from a CACAO 2.0 playbook by SecOps-NG

SKELETON — CACAO v2 scaffold for the DORA Chapter III major-ICT-related incident reporting lifecycle a financial entity discharges to its competent authority per DORA Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 Article 19. Composes the operator-side notification cycle keyed on the three DORA-specific milestones (initial notification within 4h of major classification / no later than 24h from awareness per Art. 19(4)(a); intermediate report within 72h of major classification per Art. 19(4)(b);…

**Regulatory anchors**
- DORA — Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 19 — Reporting of major ICT-related incidents and voluntary notification of significant cyber threats
- DORA — Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 18 — Classification of ICT-related incidents and cyber threats
- NIS2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555, Article 23 — Reporting obligations (cross-regime parallel notification)
- GDPR Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Articles 33-34 — Notification of a personal data breach

**Controls:** 3 control reference(s) in the canonical source, mapped under `content/mappings/`.

**Before you run it**
- Inputs the trigger expects from you: `__incident_id__`, `__reporting_window__`, `__classification_criteria__`, `__classified_at__`, `__aggregation__`, `__aware_at__`, `__source_url__`, `__initial_submitted_at__`, `__initial_impact__`, `__initial_mitigation__`, `__initial_submission_ref__`, `__intermediate_submitted_at__`, `__intermediate_impact__`, `__intermediate_mitigation__`, `__intermediate_submission_ref__`, `__final_submitted_at__`, `__final_impact__`, `__final_mitigation__`, `__final_submission_ref__`, `__cross_regime_refs__`, `__workflow_id__`, `__execution_id__`, `__captured_at__`
- Code nodes name the deterministic primitive each step runs; bind them to where your primitives execute, or replace the body:
  - detect and classify → `content.playbooks.dora_major_incident_reporting.primitives.classification.classify_major_incident`
  - notify authority initial → `content.playbooks.dora_major_incident_reporting.primitives.notification.compose_initial_notification`
  - notify authority intermediate → `content.playbooks.dora_major_incident_reporting.primitives.notification.compose_intermediate_report`
  - notify authority final → `content.playbooks.dora_major_incident_reporting.primitives.notification.compose_final_report`
  - close and archive → `content.playbooks.dora_major_incident_reporting.primitives.archive.compose_cycle_archive`
- This file carries no credentials; connectors and secrets are yours to attach.

**Source** https://github.com/secops-ng/secops-ng-framework/tree/main/content/playbooks/dora_major_incident_reporting
Regenerate with `python -m tools.compile content/playbooks/dora_major_incident_reporting/playbook.cacao.json --target n8n`; do not hand-edit the compiled file. Apache-2.0.
